label: Co-possible Grim Reaper pieces along a spaced populated descent glue into one world
paraphrase: OPEN analyst gluing premise, attribution deferred (Grim Reaper patchwork style, metric version): for the supplied station-register frame and real time clock, in every history v accessible from the selected world, along every strictly descending sequence of moments c starting at a populated moment whose consecutive slots all last at least some fixed positive duration, if for every n some world accessible from v realizes the local pieces of stations n and n + 1 together, then some single world accessible from v realizes the local pieces of all stations along c. It asserts no piece is possible. Because no world realizes every piece along a descent (a theorem), this typed premise for a given frame is equivalent to 'along every spaced populated descent, adjacent pieces are not all co-possible'; its warrant must come from the general recombination principle it instantiates. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter; the Lean type does not enforce the esse reading.
